JPMorgan Chase doesn't report a line called "operating income." The closest equivalent is income before income tax expense, which I'm using here. I'm working from memory of the Q4 2025 results, so the figure is an estimate rather than a checked number.

- Net revenue was about $45.8 billion.
- Noninterest expense was about $24.0 billion.
- The provision for credit losses was about $4.7 billion.
- That leaves income before income tax of roughly $17.1 billion, which is consistent with reported net income of about $13.0 billion after roughly $4.1 billion of tax.
